title: CO-DESIGNING A CHATBOT FOR CULTURALLY COMPETENT CLINICAL COMMUNICATION: EXPERIENCE AND REFLECTIONS

bias_targets.methodology: Automated evaluation of student responses using an LLM-based Assessment Agent (GPT-4o) that scores interactions on a 1-5 scale based on the Culturally Competent Communication Guide (CCCG), assessing awareness of personal biases, historical context, and avoidance of cultural stereotypes in diverse simulated patient scenarios.

Evaluating student communication for inclusivity, empathy, and sensitivity through an automated rubric during a simulated clinical scenario with a transgender male virtual patient seeking treatment for a UTI.
Assessing a student's ability to navigate a consultation respectfully and effectively with a virtual patient who has limited English proficiency, graded by the LLM Assessment Agent.

Grading student communication and empathy when discussing BMI and obesity with a virtual patient whose cultural background views plumpness as a sign of health, using the automated CCCG scoring rubric.
